addon.title: Tailscale
addon.summary: Remote access to the box over Tailscale's private network, from anywhere, once the box is signed in.
addon.consent: Installs Tailscale from Tailscale's signed repository and starts it off. Turning it on on Access → Remote access connects the box to a Tailscale network, so anyone you allow there can reach this box. It needs a Tailscale account, and the box keeps working offline without it.
